prompt:
Image 1 shows a chibi knight carrying a sword and a blue shield, from several angles. Image 2 shows the same knight carrying a wooden longbow and a brown leather quiver of arrows, from several angles. Draw ONLY the carried items, on their own, with no character, in exactly the same pixel-art style, colours and dark outline.

Layout: exactly 4 rows and 5 columns on a completely flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Each item is centred in an evenly spaced grid cell, with clear magenta space around it. Every item in a row is the same object and the same size, seen from a different angle.

Row 1: the steel sword, pointing down and slightly outward, as it hangs from the hand.
Row 2: the blue shield with the white cross.
Row 3: the wooden longbow with its pale string, held upright.
Row 4: the brown leather quiver with white arrow fletchings.

The five columns are the viewing angles of the knight who carries the item:
Column 1: seen from the front.
Column 2: seen from the front and to the right, three-quarter view.
Column 3: seen from the right side.
Column 4: seen from behind and to the right, three-quarter view.
Column 5: seen from behind. The back of the shield shows dark wood and leather straps, not the cross.

Do not include: hands, arms, people, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
